signIn.title: Sign in to Persisty
signIn.body: Use your e-mail. Your account is created the first time, with no password.
signIn.codeBody: We sent a code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes, once.
signIn.intentNotify: Once you sign in, you will get an e-mail when a new version is out.
signIn.intentEnterprise: Once you sign in, we record your interest in Enterprise and get in touch by e-mail.
signIn.privacy: Your e-mail is used for the account, the licence and the notices you ask for. Nothing else.
signIn.terms: By signing in you accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

errors.invalidEmail: That e-mail looks incomplete. Check it and try again.
errors.invalidCode: The code is only digits, 6 to 10 of them.
errors.rateLimited: Too many code requests in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.expired: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the e-mail or ask for another.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

account.title: My account
account.loadError: We couldn't load all of your account. Reload the page to try again.

plan.title: Plan
plan.none: The core features, with no time limit.
plan.pastDue: The last payment didn't go through. Update your card in the portal.

subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.body: Pay by card, through Stripe. Cancel any time.
subscribe.teamBody: One seat per person, on one bill. Your personal Pro stays until you cancel it.

teams.title: Teams
teams.member: You are on the {name} team, on the {plan} plan.
teams.seats: {used} of {seats, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}
teams.removeHint: {name} leaves the team and frees the seat.
teams.invited: Invite created. Send the link to {email}.
teams.linkHint: We don't send an invite e-mail. Send this link: whoever signs in with the invited e-mail joins the team.
teams.full: All seats are taken. Buy more in the portal to invite someone.

errors.full: There is no free seat. Buy more in the portal.
errors.taken: That e-mail is already on the team or already invited.
errors.invalidEmail: That e-mail doesn't look complete. Check it and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only the team's owner or an admin can do that.

notify.title: New versions
notify.on: You get an e-mail when a new version of Persisty is out.
notify.onPlatforms: You get an e-mail when a new version is out for {platforms}.
notify.off: Get an e-mail when a new version of Persisty is out.

devices.title: Devices
devices.hint: Computers with Persisty signed in to this account. The licence covers up to 5.
devices.empty: No devices yet. When you sign in from the app, it shows up here.
devices.confirmHint: {name} leaves this account and frees its place. To use Pro on it again, sign in from the app.

checkout.waiting: Payment received. Your plan shows up here in a moment.
checkout.late: Stripe hasn't confirmed the payment yet. Reload the page in a minute.

team.none: You are not on a team yet. Team brings Pro to each person, on one bill.

overview.gainBody: These are the features marked Pro in the app. Subscribe and they reach the app by themselves, with nothing to reinstall.
overview.teamBody: One seat per person, on one bill, with invites by e-mail. {price} per person, per month.

cancel.reasonTitle: Why do you want to cancel?
cancel.reasonBody: Your answer goes straight to the people who make Persisty. Picking a reason is optional.

reasons.too_expensive: It costs too much for me
reasons.problems: I had problems with the app

cancel.discountTitle: How about paying less and staying?
cancel.discountBody: 25% off your next two charges: {price} {per} instead of {full}. Then it goes back to the usual price by itself.
cancel.losesTitle: What stops working at the end of the period
cancel.freeBody: The next charge doesn't happen and {plan} goes on for 30 more days. You decide later, with no rush.
cancel.confirmBody: {plan} stays until {date}. Then Persisty goes back to the free plan.
cancel.confirmTeam: The whole {name} team goes back to free on that date.
cancel.nothingLost: Nothing you saved is lost: restore points can still be restored and requests in the queue still count.
cancel.undoHint: Until then, you can undo it in My account.
cancel.refundBody: Your first purchase was less than 7 days ago. Cancelling now sends {amount} back to your card and ends {plan} at once. Your bank may take a few days to show it.
cancel.duplicateBody: Your plan carries on through the {name} team. Cancelling this personal subscription only ends its charge.

done.discount: Done: 25% off your next two charges.
done.free_month: Done: the next charge won't happen.
done.refunded: Cancelled and refunded. The money goes back to your card in a few days.

errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.offer_used: That offer was already used on this account.
errors.not_refundable: The automatic refund is only for the 7 days after a first purchase.
errors.unknown: We couldn't finish that now. Try again in a moment.

cancel.simulate: Try cancelling (nothing is charged or saved)
